checks: The base Ridge KEEP/SWITCH/FLAT state machine was reconstructed from immutable GitHub Actions artifact 8616632878.
All 720 session, side, asset and threshold routes were selected using 2023H2 only before 2024H1 predictions were generated.
The selected filter was frozen as all UTC hours, long-only, BTCUSDT/SOLUSDT/XRPUSDT and threshold multiplier 0.75.
The 2024H1 model and calibration threshold used only information available before 2024-01-01.
Entries occurred at the next hourly open and all symbols shared one global slot.
Exits were driven only by expected-edge disappearance or a superior eligible alternative; no elapsed-time liquidation existed.
The same chronological decisions were replayed at 12, 18 and 24 basis points with an adverse funding proxy.
Winner event keys were removed before candidate competition and the complete account was rerouted.
No credential or order path was used.
scope_boundary: This validates the causal calculation and retirement of the exact hourweek/filter family. It does not validate exact Bybit execution or any later interval.
